landing.metaDescription: Plan your own trip: mark places on a map with private notes, sort them into days, and see the route for each day.
landing.title: Your trip, your way.
landing.lead: Mark places on the map, organise the days and see the route between them, on foot, by bike or by car.

mark.title: Mark
mark.body: Search or tap the map to save places, with notes only you can read.

organise.title: Organise
organise.body: Put places into days and reorder them with a drag or a tap.

follow.title: Follow
follow.body: See distance and time for each day and open each leg in your maps app.

explore.lead: Public trips from other travellers. Copy one and make it yours.
